partition_and_scope.environment_role: training-only branch mechanism diagnostic; no tuning on outcomes

reserved_seed_audit.exact_token_search_pre_protocol_creation: No matches for 4200000001-4200000004 in repository text/JSON/JSONL artifacts.
reserved_seed_audit.caveat: Historical pilot schedules are incomplete. These are reserved only as this diagnostic's training-only data, never claimed fresh for evaluation.

fields_compared: collision, damage, progress, finish, and retirement info
accessible Box2D position/velocity/angle/angular velocity, damage state/effects, off-track counter, visited tiles, and simulator time
prefix_replay_gate.limitation: This is exact repeat parity for the compared visible and exposed simulator state in the same local runtime, not a formal proof that all hidden solver state is equal.

base_source_outcomes.interpretation: These are controls for exact local branch comparisons, not a model screen or estimate of generalization.

local_observations: COAST at track 1 / geometry 4200000001 / decision 64 changed two baseline nonfinishes into finishes.
COAST at track 1 / geometry 4200000003 / decision 128 changed a baseline nonfinish into a finish.
COAST at track 2 / geometry 4200000004 / decision 64 changed a baseline finish into a nonfinish.
One selected STEER_MINUS branch had no actual native action change on either option decision due to clipping; it was retained as a no-op branch check.
Both selected BRAKE branches reduced final progress (0.6360 to 0.1544 and 0.5037 to 0.1544) without changing finish status.
The selected STEER_MINUS branch also did not change finish status.

interpretation.supported: Exact local prefix replay works for the 16 tested track/geometry cells in this runtime. For these fixed branch contexts, v1 COAST sometimes rescued a base nonfinish and also once derailed a base finish; the same learned option is not uniformly beneficial. V2's sparse selected branches included two Brake cases with sharply lower progress.
interpretation.not_supported: No conclusion that v1 or v2 improves a full episode policy, that either intervention has a general causal effect across road geometry, or that local mirror performance predicts an official result.
interpretation.dependence: 32 branch contexts are nested within 16 track/geometry cells and only four road-geometry seeds. The v1/v2 branches at the same base state share a control trajectory; branch contexts are not independent samples.
interpretation.decision: Do not retrain or tune from this diagnostic alone. A future study would need a separately frozen training-only branch sample, per-step outcome logging, and geometry-clustered replication; no existing consumed development or reserved blind cell is promoted or reused.
